systems.system: Civil-status sub-system of the national health information system
systems.tiers: listed as one of the sub-systems completing the routine SNIGS; what it does is not described

note: The passages are the health statistics yearbook's front matter and its method note: routine health reports go on paper from facility to health zone and are keyed at the zone. A civil-status sub-system is named without description, and nothing says how births or deaths are registered.
